caption: Ibergeregg Pass, Schwyz

description: The Ibergeregg road crests at about 1406 metres in the municipality of Schwyz, where a small inn and a chapel sit above moor and tawny pasture, with Furggelenstock and Firstspitz on either side. Oberiberg village is farther southeast and is not this summit. The Mythen stay distant, so this is not the town portrait of those peaks. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast and cool, with a light breeze and no rain.
